candidates.snippet: 🤡 Lavrov calls Western claims linking Moscow to the Leipzig drone incident "the start of a real war." He says Russia was blamed before any investigation. He compares Germany shutting Russian facilities and limiting representation to pre-World War II steps.
Along with Trump's special envoys, the national security advisers of the UK, France, and Germany are also currently in Kyiv. https://t.co/mFHWq9GrYc
Also near Sochi, S-300 positions in the Sirius settlement were hit. Two launchers were destroyed, along with a Pantsir air defense system of an unknown variant. https://t.co/5C69Heuhkf
